# Genovo Technologies

> Systems-first technology platform building high-precision software infrastructure, deterministic operating systems, execution security guardrails, and compiler toolchains.

## Core Platforms

- [Synthos](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/products/synthos): Entropic dataset validation engine eliminating structural pipeline drift across deep computation architectures.
- [SCOS](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/products/scos): System Control Operating System: a bare-metal microkernel hypervisor built for city-scale autonomy, robotics, and sub-millisecond interrupts.
- [Asphallea](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/products/asphallea): Zero-trust security utility enforcing capability boundaries, syscall containment, and runtime tool guardrails.

## Research & Engineering Assets

- [COBOL-to-Go Migration Tool](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/research): Modernization utility designed to parse and translate enterprise COBOL infrastructure directly into Go.
- [SRE Agent](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/research): Automated site reliability engineering tool for telemetry anomaly detection and self-healing infrastructure.
- [TocinLang](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/research): High-performance systems programming language featuring a custom lexer/parser targeting LLVM IR.
- [EPOCH VCS](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/research): Distributed version control system built with C++ and Rust leveraging Merkle DAGs.
- [TosinOS](https://genovotechnologies.github.io/website/#/research): 32-bit protected-mode monolithic operating system kernel written in x86 Assembly and C.
